headline: DeepSeek reportedly raises about $15 billion in a Chinese funding round
body: DeepSeek has raised about $15 billion, about 100 billion yuan, in one of the biggest funding rounds in the country, Bloomberg reported. Potential investors include CATL and Tencent, according to the report.
note: For finance people, funding of this size shows how much capital Chinese AI labs can still attract. The report also notes that DeepSeek faces restrictions in the U.S.

evidence.text: Just two days after the U.S. ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek's AI technology from their systems over security concerns, the Chinese AI lab has raised about $15 billion, about 100 billion yuan, one of the biggest funding rounds in the country, Bloomberg reported.
Potential investors include Chinese battery maker CATL and Tencent, the company behind WeChat, among others, according to the report.
The Hangzhou-based AI startup is ramping up spending on AI infrastructure and open models for domestic and international markets, even as it faces restrictions in the U.S., the report said.
